subtitle: Why working code can miss the product

sections.heading: Prompt
sections.body: "Implement a weekly feedback tool" was too vague.

sections.heading: Result
sections.body: The agent built a CLI for weekly project health.

sections.heading: Risk
sections.body: Missing product decisions become model assumptions.

sections.heading: Fix
sections.body: Specify users, workflow, MVP scope, and out-of-scope items before code.
